claims: Only four golfers in history have won the Masters Tournament in consecutive years.
Jack Nicklaus won the Masters Tournament in 1965 and 1966.
Nick Faldo won the Masters Tournament in 1989 and 1990.
Tiger Woods won the Masters Tournament in 2001 and 2002.
Rory McIlroy won the Masters Tournament in 2025 and 2026.
18 golfers have won multiple Green Jackets.
Jack Nicklaus won the Masters 6 times in 1963, 1965, 1966, 1972, 1975, 1986.
Tiger Woods won the Masters 5 times in 1997, 2001, 2002, 2005, 2019.
Arnold Palmer won the Masters 4 times in 1958, 1960, 1962, 1964.
Jimmy Demaret won the Masters 3 times.
Sam Snead won the Masters 3 times.
Gary Player won the Masters 3 times.
Nick Faldo won the Masters 3 times.
Phil Mickelson won the Masters 3 times.
Horton Smith won the Masters 2 times.
Byron Nelson won the Masters 2 times.
Ben Hogan won the Masters 2 times.
Tom Watson won the Masters 2 times.
Seve Ballesteros won the Masters 2 times.
Bernhard Langer won the Masters 2 times.
Ben Crenshaw won the Masters 2 times.
Jose Maria Olazabal won the Masters 2 times.
Bubba Watson won the Masters 2 times.
Scottie Scheffler won the Masters 2 times.
According to tradition, the previous year's winner puts the green jacket on the new winner.
According to tradition, for repeat champions, the Augusta National chairman handles the honors.
Rory McIlroy became the first player in over two decades to win consecutive Masters.
Rory McIlroy achieved this feat at the 2026 tournament.
